result.instructions: Tools for Drip, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscribers got the Black Friday broadcast, and how many opened it?"; "List all subscribers tagged VIP who joined this year."; "Tag jane@example.com as Customer and record a Purchased event for her.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Drip data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run drip_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run drip_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run drip_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. drip_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: drip_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the Drip accounts this API token can access, with id, name, website and sending address. Drip API: GET /v2/accounts.

tools.name: drip_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List subscribers (contacts) in the account, filterable by status, tag and subscribe date. Paginated. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/subscribers.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags: return only subscribers with these tags.

subscribed_after.description: ISO-8601 datetime: subscribed after this time.

subscribed_before.description: ISO-8601 datetime: subscribed before this time.

tools.name: drip_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber with tags, custom fields, lead score and lifetime value. Look it up by Drip id, email or visitor uuid. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/subscribers/{id_or_email_or_visitor_uuid}.

subscriber.description: Drip subscriber id, email address or visitor uuid.

tools.name: drip_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List every tag used in the account. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/tags.

tools.name: drip_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom field identifiers
tools.description: List the custom field names defined on subscribers in the account. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/custom_field_identifiers.

tools.name: drip_list_campaigns
tools.title: List email series campaigns
tools.description: List email series campaigns (drip campaigns), filterable by status. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/campaigns.

tools.name: drip_get_campaign
tools.title: Get an email series campaign
tools.description: Get one email series campaign by id. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}.

tools.name: drip_list_broadcasts
tools.title: List broadcasts
tools.description: List single-email campaigns (broadcasts), filterable by status such as draft, scheduled, sending or sent. Paginated. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/broadcasts.

status.description: Filter by broadcast status, e.g. draft, scheduled, sending, sent.

tools.name: drip_get_broadcast
tools.title: Get a broadcast
tools.description: Get one broadcast (single-email campaign) by id. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/broadcasts/{broadcast_id}.

tools.name: drip_list_workflows
tools.title: List workflows
tools.description: List automation workflows, filterable by status. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/workflows.

tools.name: drip_get_workflow
tools.title: Get a workflow
tools.description: Get one workflow by id. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/workflows/{workflow_id}.

tools.name: drip_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the sign-up forms in the account. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/forms.

tools.name: drip_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List the saved subscriber segments in the account. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/segments.

tools.name: drip_get_email_metrics
tools.title: Get email metrics
tools.description: Get sent, open, click and unsubscribe metrics for emails in a date range, optionally per broadcast, workflow or campaign. Drip API: GET /v2/{account_id}/metrics/email.

start_date.description: First day, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). Defaults to 30 days before end_date.

end_date.description: Last day, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). Defaults to today.

tools.name: drip_upsert_subscriber
tools.title: Create or update a subscriber
tools.description: Create a subscriber, or update it when the email already exists, with name, address fields and custom field values. Adds no tags: use drip_apply_tag. Drip API: POST /v2/{account_id}/subscribers.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name.

tools.name: drip_apply_tag
tools.title: Apply a tag to a subscriber
tools.description: Apply one tag to a subscriber by email. Applying a tag twice has no further effect. Drip API: POST /v2/{account_id}/tags.

tag.description: The tag to apply, e.g. Customer.

annotations.title: Apply a tag to a subscriber

tools.name: drip_remove_tag
tools.title: Remove a tag from a subscriber
tools.description: Remove one tag from a subscriber by email. Drip API: DELETE /v2/{account_id}/subscribers/{email}/tags/{tag}.

annotations.title: Remove a tag from a subscriber

tools.name: drip_record_event
tools.title: Record a subscriber event
tools.description: Record a named action for a subscriber (for example 'Purchased'), which can start workflows and emails in Drip. Drip API: POST /v2/{account_id}/events.

occurred_at.description: ISO-8601 time the event happened (default now).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Drip
prompts.description: What you can do with Drip here, with example requests to try.
